hero.headline: Hardware built for your salon.
hero.subhead: Every piece of Certxa hardware is designed to work seamlessly with your software — out of the box, same day.

mainProducts.name: Certxa Station
mainProducts.tagline: The full front desk, all in one.
mainProducts.description: A sleek all-in-one touchscreen terminal that runs your entire front desk. Check clients in, manage the queue, process payments, print receipts, and close the day — all from one device. Built for busy salons with multiple technicians.

highlights.text: USB hub for printer and cash drawer
Offline mode — keeps working without internet

mainProducts.name: Certxa Kiosk
mainProducts.tagline: The self check-in kiosk and customer screen in one.
mainProducts.description: A tablet kiosk that lets clients check in, browse services with photos and pricing, pick their nail length, shape, and design, and join the queue — all without staff involvement. Also works as a customer-facing checkout screen paired with Certxa Station.

highlights.text: Self check-in with service photos and pricing
Nail length, shape, and design selection
Loyalty points display and reward redemption
Pairs with Certxa Station or runs standalone

accessories.name: T-Mobile REVVL TAB 2 5G | 64GB 10.1" Tablet
accessories.description: A dedicated display that faces the client at checkout — shows their bill, tip options, and loyalty balance in real time.

accessories.name: IP Thermal Receipt Printer
accessories.description: 80mm thermal printer with network (IP) connectivity. Fast, quiet, and reliable — prints receipts, check-in slips, and end-of-day reports.

accessories.name: Cash Drawer
accessories.description: Sturdy steel cash drawer that connects directly to the Certxa Station via USB. Auto-opens on cash transactions.

accessories.name: Stripe M2 Card Reader
accessories.description: A compact wireless card reader powered by Stripe. Accept chip, tap, and swipe payments, plus Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay, at the chair or the front desk.
accessories.compatible: Works with any device running Certxa

payments.headline: Transparent processing rates. No hidden fees.
payments.subhead: Certxa Payments is powered by Stripe Connect. Stripe's rate plus a $0.60 Certxa fee per card payment — no monthly fee.

tiers.name: Standard rate
tiers.rateNote: per in-person card payment (Stripe's rate), plus a $0.60 Certxa fee

payments.note: Online card payments are 2.9% + 30¢ (Stripe's rate), plus the same $0.60 Certxa fee per card payment. Payments run through Stripe Connect.

faq.question: What hardware does Certxa offer?
faq.answer: Certxa's main device is the Certxa Station (the full front desk terminal). Accessories include a customer facing screen, IP thermal receipt printer, cash drawer, and the Stripe M2 card reader.

faq.question: How much is the card reader?
faq.answer: The Stripe M2 Card Reader is $69. It works with every Certxa plan, and there is no minimum processing volume.

faq.question: Is the hardware difficult to set up?
faq.answer: No. All Certxa hardware is plug-and-play. Connect it to your Certxa account and you're ready to go — most salons are up and running the same day their hardware arrives.

faq.question: What payment types are accepted?
faq.answer: All Certxa hardware supports chip (EMV), contactless tap-to-pay (NFC), and major digital wallets including Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay. Swipe and keyed-in transactions are also supported.

faq.question: Does the hardware work if the internet goes down?
faq.answer: Yes. Certxa Station includes offline mode — tickets are saved locally and synced automatically when your connection is restored. No lost sales, no interruptions.
